Changes: selected, filtered and computed on by this project. The IVs and moves are computed with the rate FRED DTB3: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), 3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis [DTB3], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DTB3, 2026-10-29 (public domain). Not under CC BY-SA: the labels made from Yahoo Finance prices (security.in_universe and timing_check.gap_verdict_yf, and the share of gap contradictions built from it) fall under Yahoo's terms of service. No Cboe data is committed.
